name: openfheorg/openfhe-development
description: A comprehensive C++ Fully Homomorphic Encryption library implementing all major FHE schemes (BFV, BGV, CKKS, FHEW/TFHE) with bootstrapping and scheme switching. Enables computation over encrypted data without access to the secret key.
score_rationale: The leading open-source FHE library with 1.1k stars and a February 2026 release, consolidating multiple FHE schemes into a single actively maintained codebase.
